title: "10. 底格里斯河畔亚历山大城的确认与城市景观"
subtitle: "Alexandria on the Tigris and its urban landscape"
---

## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** Charax Spasinou位于底格里斯—卡伦河与波斯湾交通体系的关键节点，是研究希腊化、帕提亚时期美索不达米亚与印度洋贸易的理想城市。地点早在1960年代已由航片提出，真正的新问题是城市如何组织：街区、神庙、作坊、港池、运河和农业腹地如何共同构成一个连接海运与河运的转运中心，以及河道改道如何改变城市命运。

**English.** Charax Spasinou occupied a strategic junction linking the Tigris–Karun river system with the Persian Gulf and Indian Ocean trade. Its location had been proposed from aerial photography decades ago; the more important current question is how the city actually functioned. Street grids, temples, workshops, harbour basins, canals, and the agricultural hinterland together allow reconstruction of a trans-shipment city and of how river migration shaped its rise and decline.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** Charax Spasinou（底格里斯河畔亚历山大城）的位置早在20世纪中期已由航片研究提出。2016年以来的新项目通过地表调查、无人机、磁力测量和陶器分析持续揭示网格化街道、住宅区、神庙、作坊、港池、运河与农业腹地。2026年的媒体报道是对这一多年工作的阶段性总结，而不是2026年才首次确定遗址位置。

**English.** The location of Charax Spasinou (Alexandria on the Tigris) had been proposed from aerial photography decades before 2026. Since 2016, renewed survey, drone mapping, magnetometry and ceramic analysis have progressively revealed a gridded city with residential areas, temples, workshops, harbour basins, canals and an agricultural hinterland. The 2026 reporting is therefore best understood as a synthesis of a multi-year project rather than the first identification of the site.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 2026年成果的价值不在于“首次确认地点”，而在于首次系统揭示城市布局、功能分区与基础设施。该项目把古代远距离贸易从“发现外来商品”推进到研究维系贸易的城市基础设施。它连接印度洋海运、波斯湾、底格里斯河运与美索不达米亚腹地，也把城市兴衰与河道迁移、海岸线变化放在同一分析框架。

**English.** The project moves the archaeology of long-distance exchange beyond imported goods toward the infrastructure that sustained exchange. It connects Indian Ocean shipping, the Persian Gulf, Tigris river transport, and the Mesopotamian interior while linking urban fortunes to river migration and shoreline change.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

Campbell, S., Hauser, S. R., Killick, R., Moon, J., Shepperson, M., & Doležálková, V. (2018). Charax Spasinou: New investigations at the capital of Mesene. *Zeitschrift für Orient-Archäologie, 11*. https://doi.org/10.34780/te7a-edx2

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 期刊页面为订阅访问；没有确认通用开放许可。 / Subscription access on the journal site; no general open licence confirmed.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章汇总 Charax Spasinou 项目的地表调查、陶器和城市考古成果，讨论这座希腊化—帕提亚时期港口城市的规模、年代与功能。它的重要性不在于2026年才找到遗址，而在于把长期已知的位置转化为可以分析街区、宗教、手工业、港口与区域贸易的城市考古资料。

**What the publication shows (English).** The article synthesizes surface survey, ceramic and urban evidence from the Charax Spasinou project to clarify the scale, chronology and functions of this Hellenistic–Parthian port city. Its contribution is not the first location of the site, but the conversion of a long-suspected location into an archaeologically analyzable urban landscape of neighbourhoods, religion, craft, harbour infrastructure and regional trade.
